DICOM De-Identification Profiles and Composable Jurisdictions

Source: R/deid-profile.R
dicom_deid_profile.Rd

Compiles declarative DICOM PS3.15 Annex E Table E.1-1 confidentiality profiles, standard confidentiality options, safe-private creator allowlists, and composable statutory jurisdiction overlays into a concrete, deterministic tag mutator table.

Usage

dicom_deid_profile(
  profile = "ps3.15",
  options = character(0),
  jurisdictions = NULL,
  file = NULL,
  override_tags = list(),
  date_shift = NULL,
  dob_policy = NULL,
  patient_deid = TRUE,
  deidentify = TRUE
)

Arguments

profile

Character string identifying the base profile. Default is "ps3.15" (DICOM PS3.15 Annex E Basic Application Level Confidentiality Profile).

options

Character vector of standard PS3.15 options to enable. Valid options include:

  • "clean_pixel_data" (CID 7050 113101)

  • "clean_recognizable_visual_features" (CID 7050 113102)

  • "clean_graphics" (CID 7050 113103)

  • "clean_structured_content" (CID 7050 113104)

  • "clean_descriptors" (CID 7050 113105)

  • "retain_longitudinal_full_dates" (CID 7050 113106)

  • "retain_longitudinal_modified_dates" (CID 7050 113107)

  • "retain_patient_characteristics" (CID 7050 113108)

  • "retain_device_identity" (CID 7050 113109)

  • "retain_institution_identity" (CID 7050 113110)

  • "retain_safe_private" (CID 7050 113111)

  • "retain_uids" (CID 7050 113112)

jurisdictions

Optional character vector of statutory jurisdiction overlays to compose onto the profile. See dicom_list_jurisdictions for available presets. Default is NULL (pure PS3.15 standard rules).

file

Optional file path to a custom YAML profile definition. If provided, overrides profile.

override_tags

Optional named list of tag-action overrides (e.g., list("(0010,0010)" = "X", "(0008,1030)" = "C")) applied after all base rules, options, and jurisdictions have been resolved.

date_shift

Optional logical. Whether date shifting is explicitly enabled (TRUE) or disabled (FALSE). If NULL (default), date shifting is determined by active options (e.g. "retain_longitudinal_modified_dates") and jurisdictions.

dob_policy

Optional character string specifying policy for date of birth ("year_month", "year_only", "shift_per_patient", "dummy", or "keep"). Default is NULL (resolved from base profile and active jurisdictions, e.g. "year_month" for Singapore PDPA/HIB).

patient_deid

Logical. Whether patient-level de-identification is enabled. Default is TRUE. If FALSE, all patient identification tags (Group (0010,xxxx) such as PatientName, PatientID, PatientBirthDate, PatientSex) are retained intact ("K") for operational or clinical routing use.

deidentify

Logical. Whether general de-identification is enabled. Default is TRUE. If FALSE, de-identification is entirely bypassed and all tags are retained ("K") for operational use.

Value

An object of class "dicom_deid_profile" containing:

profile

Profile name or file identifier.

description

Human-readable profile description.

cid7050_codes

Named character vector of CID 7050 codes and meanings.

date_policy

Resolved date policy ("dummy", "shift_per_patient", "year_only", or "keep").

date_shift

Explicit date shift setting (TRUE, FALSE, or NULL).

dob_policy

Resolved date of birth policy (e.g. "year_month", "year_only", or NULL).

patient_deid

Logical indicating whether patient-level de-identification is active.

deidentify

Logical indicating whether general de-identification is active.

age_cap_years

Integer age cap (e.g. 89L) or NULL.

zip_prefix_digits

Integer retained zip prefix digits (e.g. 3L) or NULL.

regex_scrubbers

Character vector of regular expression patterns for text scrubbing.

disclaimers

Character vector of legal disclaimers associated with active jurisdictions.

flags

Named list of arbitrary jurisdictional or workflow flags.

safe_private

Named list of allowlisted private creators and offset numbers.

tags

Tibble of compiled tags with columns tag, action, name, keyword, and vr.

Details

Conflicting tag rules across composed options and jurisdictions merge monotonically along the strictest-wins join-semilattice:


  K (keep) < C (clean) < U (UID) < D (dummy) < Z (zero) < X (remove)

Adding any statutory jurisdiction overlay (e.g., "hipaa_safe_harbor", "sg_pdpa_hib", "gdpr") cannot weaken base protection.

Examples

# Basic PS3.15 Profile
prof <- dicom_deid_profile()
print(prof)
#> === dicom_deid_profile: ps3.15 ===
#> Description: DICOM PS3.15 Annex E Table E.1-1 Basic Application Level Confidentiality Profile
#> 
#> CID 7050 Codes:
#>   * [113100] Basic Application Confidentiality Profile
#> 
#> Configuration & Policies:
#>   * Date Policy: dummy
#>   * Age Cap: None
#>   * Zip Prefix: None
#>   * Options (0): none
#>   * Jurisdictions (0): none
#>   * Safe Private Creators: 0 allowlisted
#>   * Regex Text Scrubbers: 0 active
#> 
#> Tag Action Breakdown (273 tags):
#>   U: 19 | X: 234 | Z: 20

# Longitudinal research with safe private tags and Singapore HIB + HIPAA
prof_multi <- dicom_deid_profile(
  options = c("retain_longitudinal_modified_dates", "retain_safe_private"),
  jurisdictions = c("sg_pdpa_hib", "hipaa_safe_harbor")
)

# Operational mode (patient identity retained intact)
prof_ops <- dicom_deid_profile(patient_deid = FALSE)
